humanAuthorization.reference: conversation: user authorized autonomous corrective Work Item execution and required a corrective Work Item before any workflow fix

rationale: The removed test required global rejection of every recoverable foreign duplicate. Issue #653 replaces that obsolete requirement with task-aware handling: unrelated Work Items must start, while requested-task duplicates remain fail closed. The two listed regressions preserve and strengthen the safety boundary through same-task and normal ai-start coverage.
